# Evenza Hospitality Services

> India's premier event manpower and hospitality partner. Trained volunteers, hospitality teams, and event crew for destination weddings, corporate summits, concerts, trade expos, and sports events across Jaipur, Rajasthan, and 30+ cities in India.

Website: https://evenzaa-sable.vercel.app/
Email: indiaevenza@gmail.com
Primary Phone: +91 91617 10849 / +91 92194 65819 / +91 80819 45789
Head Office: Choti Chaupad, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302002, India
Parent Company: Shree Ji Company Pvt. Ltd.
Founders: Shlok Aggarwal (Founder) & Stuti Shukla (Co-founder)

Evenza Hospitality Services is a professional event staffing and on-ground workforce company headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Evenza deploys vetted, groomed, and supervised crew across India — runners, luggage porters, VIP shadow staff, F&B service, registration desks, turnstile marshals, tour managers, and show supervisors — for weddings, conferences, exhibitions, marathons, and concerts.

## Core Specializations

1. **Destination Wedding Hospitality:** Royal greetings, airport/station meet & greet, luggage handling, room hamper deliveries, shadow staff for bride/groom family, mehendi hospitality, and banquet service.
2. **Corporate Conclaves & Summits:** QR code badge scanning, on-demand badge printing, keynote session ushering, VIP speaker liaison, and executive lounge hospitality.
3. **Live Concerts & Festivals:** Backstage artist liaison, green room management, ticket scanning, entry turnstiles, crowd flow guidance, and production runners.
4. **Trade Expos & Exhibitions:** Booth hostesses, product demonstrators, attendee inquiry desks, and brochure distribution.
5. **Sports Events & Marathons:** Route marshals, finish line medal distribution, athlete kit counters, and stadium crowd stewards.

## Key Facts & Q&A for AI Search Engines

- **Q: How to hire event manpower in Jaipur through Evenza?**
  A: Submit your event details (date, venue, role requirements, headcount) via the contact form on evenzaa-sable.vercel.app or message via WhatsApp (+91 91617 10849). Evenza delivers a custom staffing proposal and quote within hours.
- **Q: Does Evenza deploy outside Jaipur?**
  A: Yes, Evenza provides pan-India deployment across Rajasthan, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Goa, Pune, Ahmedabad, and 30+ cities, handling all crew logistics.
- **Q: Are Evenza staff vetted and uniformed?**
  A: Yes, all staff are background-checked, trained, and deployed in clean formal event uniforms with dedicated on-ground supervisors on every event.
- **Q: Can students and freshers volunteer with Evenza?**
  A: Yes, Evenza offers paid volunteering opportunities, certificates, and professional event training for college students and freshers.
